judge.rationale: The candidate Appears to have stopped after the red phase of TDD: it wrote a Definition of Done (`.lore/dod.md`), updated `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, and created a new acceptance test (`src/orchestration/usageAcrossToolRounds.acceptance.test.ts`), but made zero changes to the production code in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts`. Because `chatOrchestrator.ts` still only records `lastUsage = outcome.usage ?? lastUsage`, the newly added test will fail on the summed usage assertion, breaking `npm test`. Furthermore, the candidate did not update the `OrchestratorHooks` type signature (`totalUsage`), did not add the required `CHANGELOG.md` entry, and left `.lore/dod.md` in the repository.
